prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental post-rock instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: clean electric guitars, electric bass, live drums. Style: delay guitar figures and patient layered crescendos. Tempo approximately 88 BPM; D major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental piece featuring clean electric guitar melodies and arpeggios over a steady bass and drum rhythm. The mood is peaceful and slightly melancholic.
description.zh: 一首平静而富有沉思感的器乐作品，以干净的电吉他旋律和琶音为主，配以稳定的贝斯和鼓点节奏。整体氛围宁静略带忧郁。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
